categories.title: Igneous rocks
categories.blurb: Rocks that cooled from melt: the volcanic ones that reached the surface and the plutonic ones that stayed below it, from adakite to the granite family.

categories.title: Sedimentary rocks
categories.blurb: Rocks built from pieces, from chemistry or from living things: sandstone, limestone, chalk, coal and the evaporites left when a sea dries.

categories.title: Metamorphic rocks
categories.blurb: Rocks changed in the solid state by heat and pressure: slates, schists, gneisses, marbles and the high-grade rocks that remember a mountain belt.

categories.title: Specific varieties
categories.blurb: Named kinds that cut across the three classes: textures, ores and trade names that a geologist says instead of the family name.
